lecons.title: The television and the radio
lecons.summary: A television is an audio-visual modern ICT tool: it is used for watching moving images, listening, and playing games and music. A radio is an audio modern ICT tool: it is used for playing music, recording audio and listening to news and other programmes.
lecons.illustration_prompt: Figure composée, non générée, dessinée par work/figures-klein-cahier-nov12.py. Couverture : television, radio.

notions.statement: A television is an audio-visual modern ICT tool. It is used for watching moving images (video), listening, and playing games and music.
notions.illustration_prompt: Figure composée, non générée, dessinée par work/figures-klein-cahier-nov12.py. Fiche « The television » : audio-visual ; watch moving images ; games and music.

explanations.body: Audio-visual: we hear the sound and we see the images.
A cartoon on the TV screen, with its music.

payload.statement: We use a television to watch moving images.

payload.text: A television is an audio-{{1}} tool.

items.explain: A television is an audio-visual tool.

payload.question: What do we watch on a television?

payload.statement: A television is an old local ICT tool.

items.explain: No. It is a modern ICT tool.

notions.statement: A radio is an audio modern ICT tool. It is used for playing music, recording audio and listening to news and other programmes.
notions.illustration_prompt: Figure composée, non générée, dessinée par work/figures-klein-cahier-nov12.py. Fiche « The radio » : audio only ; music, news ; recording audio.

explanations.body: With the radio, we only hear: there are no images.
Papa listens to the news on his small radio.

payload.statement: We use a radio to listen to the news.

payload.text: A radio is an {{1}} modern ICT tool.

items.explain: A radio is an audio modern ICT tool.

payload.question: Match each tool with what it gives.

items.explain: the television → sound and images ; the radio → sound only.

payload.statement: We watch moving images on the radio.

items.explain: No. The radio gives only sound.
